review_input.original_instruction: For your start point you will begin in a bathroom exit the washroom straight ahead and enter into the bedroom. Move to the right of the front door and enter into the open doorway that would lead you into a home office. Move to the right in between the desk to your left and the leather arm chair to your right move in between both sets of furniture and make your way to the wall that has that shredder. Stand in front of that shredder and you are done.
